script:
"=== checking hermes install ==="
Get-ChildItem "C:\Users\E\AppData\Local\hermes" | Select-Object Name | Select-Object -First 10
"=== trying hermes directly ==="
$env:Path += ";C:\Users\E\AppData\Local\hermes\bin"
hermes --version 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 3
"=== check for hermes exe ==="
Get-ChildItem "C:\Users\E\AppData\Local\hermes" -Recurse -Filter "hermes.exe" 2>$null | Select-Object FullName | Select-Object -First 3
